title: Page Size Ceiling
description: The tracking table's page size can't be cranked up indefinitely — someone requesting a thousand rows at once should be turned away, not silently capped.
successCondition: GET /api/tracking?pageSize=101 as a logged-in user returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR. GET /api/tracking?pageSize=100 (the maximum) returns 200 successfully.
hints: pageSize is validated as an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive — 101 is one past the documented ceiling.
Any authenticated role works for this test since the validation happens before the ownership/visibility filtering.
